name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 32 – Am 50
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 32d. Underlines that the salaries and benefits of the highest-ranking EU officials, such as heads of directorates, are very generous, often exceeding EUR 250 000 annually; is concerned that such disproportionately high salaries distance those officials from the everyday lives, needs, and struggles of citizens; stresses that such remuneration does not effectively prevent corruption, as some EU officials have already been implicated in past corruption scandals, such as Qatargate;
